xrefs.text: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, place fire from the altar in it, and add incense. Go quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them, because wrath has come out from the LORD; the plague has begun.”

See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?
So the LORD sent a plague upon Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.
We must pay closer attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.
